title: 2-Day Pass at NASA Space Center Houston with Mission Control
includes: Instructions for booking free trams only available inside per Space Center's availability
2 days to explore the NASA Space Center at gradual pace and own freedom per NASA's daily hours
Tip Sheet (+20 languages) to maximize your NASA experience
NASA Historic Mission Control Tram ticket (1 ticket per person)
2-Day General Admission tickets & available trams inside the NASA Space Center
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

The 2-day period is consecutive, beginning on the booking date and ending at the the next following date (5:00 PM). For special exceptions, guests need to contact at least 24 hours in advance for waiver approval.
policies: Guests are responsible for arriving at the NASA Space Center at their own convenience.
The time selected during booking is your General Admission entrance time however there is flexibility to arrive at a later time.
Guests will receive their tickets by email and/or text message (including WhatsApp, when applicable) approximately one hour before the selected General Admission entry time.

Guests will receive 1 Mission Control Ticket per person for the first date of their visit or in accordance with NASA's availability at the time of booking. No duplicate or double tickets will be given for the second date of visit or date when there is no Mission Control Tram scheduled.

The Mission Control tram tour included with this package is non-refundable and can be cancelled by NASA due to inclement weather. It is very rare that NASA will cancel Mission Control Trams on two consecutive days.
Water, electronics, small packaged snacks, and backpacks are generally permitted inside.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your 2-Day General Admission Pass gives you the freedom to enjoy Space Center Houston without feeling rushed. With 400+ things to see and do, one day can make it difficult to experience everything the NASA Space Center has to offer. Spread your visit across two days and take your time exploring Rocket Park, the legendary Saturn V, Independence Plaza, Space Shuttle 905, International Space Station exhibits, Life on Mars, and more!

With your convenient 2-Day General Admission Pass, enjoy the flexibility to explore this extraordinary destination at a more relaxed pace and discover more of what NASA has to offer. Use the additional time to experience NASA's tram tours, including Historic Mission Control, along with immersive virtual reality experiences, live presentations, and interactive exhibits. You'll even have time to browse the official NASA gift shop and revisit attractions you may have missed.

See more. Experience more. Take your time!
